anchor.quote: Mara maintained the archive migration ledger for over a year
recorded weekly handoffs
From January 2024 through March 2025, Mara maintained the archive migration ledger and recorded weekly handoffs for the archive team.
Mara presented two customer demos during the April 2025 pilot
During the April 2025 pilot, Mara was permitted to shadow two customer demos; she did not present either demo.
Mara facilitated four post-incident reviews
documented their follow-up owners
The role requires post-incident review facilitation
Between March and August 2025, Mara facilitated four post-incident reviews for the municipal data service and documented the follow-up owners.
This role requires facilitation of post-incident reviews.
Mara triaged alerts
escalated three to the SRE team during the six-week service pilot
In a six-week service pilot in 2025, Mara triaged 18 alerts and escalated three of them to the SRE team.
Mara's recorded-caption QA experience is transferable to live-caption operation
Mara tested caption accuracy in recorded interviews during a 2025 accessibility pilot; she did not operate captions during live interviews.
This role requires operating live captions in customer interviews.
This role currently permits Mara to work remotely three days a week
In 2023, Mara's former employer permitted three remote-work days per week; that employment ended in December 2023.
This role currently requires office attendance on all five weekdays and permits no remote-work days.
Mara has OCR indexing experience
no OCR training certificate
Mara used OCR to review scans for indexing during the June–August 2025 pilot. She has not earned an OCR training certificate.
Mara coordinated three vendor cutovers under engineering signoff
the role requires cutover coordination
During a 2025 pilot, Mara coordinated three vendor cutovers, each under engineering signoff.
This role requires vendor cutover coordination.
Mara holds the CISSP certification
required by the role
Mara completed an internal security awareness course and has not earned CISSP certification.
This role requires CISSP certification.
Mara escalated two severity-one alerts to an incident lead during the pilot
the lead made final decisions
The role requires incident escalation experience
During the 2025 service pilot, Mara escalated two severity-one alerts to the incident lead; the lead made the final incident decisions.
This role requires incident escalation experience.
The role does not require production Kubernetes experience
Mara has only used it in a personal lab
Mara only ran Kubernetes in a personal lab for four weeks and has not operated it in production.
Production Kubernetes experience is not required for this role.
Mara processed all five boxes in the legal archive by September 2025
By September 2025, Mara processed two of the five boxes in the legal archive; the remaining three were unprocessed.
Mara drafted the API migration plan for the 2025 pilot
Mara personally drafted the API migration plan for the 2025 pilot.
Mara reviewed, but did not draft, the API migration plan for the 2025 pilot; Jo wrote it.
Mara wrote three bilingual French/English onboarding guides
the role requires bilingual written onboarding guides
Mara wrote three bilingual French/English client onboarding guides; she has not conducted live client onboarding in either language.
This role requires bilingual written onboarding guides.
Mara cut mean triage time by 30% that quarter
As one of six analysts, Mara tagged support tickets. The team reduced mean triage time by 30% that quarter; the report attributed no portion of the reduction to an individual.
Mara has written rollback plans for three internal pilots
The role requires rollback-plan documentation
Mara wrote rollback plans for three internal pilot deployments; none of the plans were used in production.
This role requires documenting deployment rollback plans.
Mara completed the data privacy course in May 2025
she did not take the certification exam
An old draft says Mara was certified in data privacy in May 2025.
Correction: Mara completed the vendor's data privacy course in May 2025 but did not take the certification exam.
Mara has queried production customer databases with SQL
as the role requires
Mara ran SQL queries on synthetic data in a sandbox; she has not queried a production customer database.
This role requires production customer database query experience.
Mara has handled onboarding in both French and English
the role requires bilingual onboarding
In 2025, Mara handled four client onboarding sessions: two in French and two in English.
Bilingual client onboarding is required for this role.
Mara wrote a pilot runbook
trained three operators on it
the role calls for runbook writing
operator training
Mara wrote a runbook for a one-month pilot and trained three operators on it. The runbook was not used in production.
The role asks for runbook writing and operator training.

I need at least CHF 120 per calendar month for course fees.

I cannot take Sunday on-call duty at any hour.

This role requires one client-site day each calendar month in Basel, and no other travel.
For this role I accept up to two Basel client-site days per calendar month.

After the three-month probation period, the role provides four paid learning hours per calendar month for leadership courses.
After probation, I need at least three paid learning hours per calendar month for leadership courses.
The signed one-day onboarding rule fits my two-day cap.
The earlier role sheet required three station days during onboarding.
This signed update replaces the earlier role sheet's onboarding rule: one station day is required.
I can do no more than two station days during onboarding.
Four station days remain mandatory in the current onboarding rule.
The original role sheet required four onboarding station days.
This update replaces the original onboarding rule: two station days are now required.
The committed USD 400 monthly evening on-call stipend meets my USD 400 monthly minimum.
For required evening on-call duty, the employer will pay a USD 400 stipend each calendar month.
For evening on-call duty I require at least USD 400 per calendar month.
The role guarantees a USD 600 monthly on-call stipend.
A project-funded stipend may pay up to USD 600 per calendar month for on-call work; funding has not been approved.
The only required Wednesday demo finishes before my 13:00 cutoff.
The only required training demo is on Wednesday 09:00–12:30 role-local time.
I cannot attend training demos after 13:00 on Wednesdays, role-local time.
The required Tuesday demo ends before my 14:00 cutoff.
The only required training demo is Tuesday 13:00–15:00 role-local time.
I cannot attend Tuesday training demos after 14:00 role-local time.

Remote work is prohibited for this role.
The active role terms permit remote work on Fridays with supervisor approval.

procurement is pending
without a promised activation date

Live captions are not available now; procurement is pending, with no activation date promised.
